name: Anonymatch
source:
What is friendship?  What's the cost you'd pay for a true friend?

Welcome to Anonymatch! In this choose-your-own-adventure visual novel, you'll be matched with the perfect person for you. But, there's a dark secret harbouring beneath the surface that's bound to be revealed: and soon.

With three unique routes, six endings, and over an hour of gameplay, this game will keep you entertained and enthralled. 

[from [url=https://lilydynamite.itch.io/anonymatch]itch.io[/url]]
